name: Put' domoj
source:
A person who doesn't believe in the salvation of the world still chooses to believe in the meaning of their own path—even if it ends in death.

Developed as part of Capella Jam 2026.

[From [url=https://lehanfox.itch.io/wayhome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个不相信世界得救的人仍然选择相信自己道路的意义——即使它的结局是死亡。

作为Capella Jam 2026的一部分开发。
